sermon.title: A Different Spirit - April 21, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Continuing from Joshua and Caleb, the message contrasts Saul and Samson, who had the Spirit upon them but lost it through disobedience, with Joshua, Daniel and Joseph, who had the Spirit in them. The Helper Jesus promised teaches, convicts and brings love, joy, peace, power and self-control, but we must accept His surgery and not just the feeling.
